name: tracker-startup-retry
goal: Retry a confirmed Tracker host startup failure once for an explicit launch even with scheduling disabled, preserve duplicate-session fencing, and alert Chief of Staff after exhaustion.

evidence: Primary #1188 source/receipt/directory match Git worktree checkout before worker creation; manual scheduling opt-out drops retry. Require safe one-shot startup retry and durable CoS alert.

Existing launch event case covered failure after a session started; add pre-start host failure, grace, duplicate fencing, same explicit token with scheduling disabled and terminal CoS inbox assertions to that existing case.
Committed b34011911e, loop record red reproduced the exact scheduling opt-out assertion: one abandoned receipt and no retry.

Retain expiry and host absence fences; persist explicit startup retry authorization through dispatcher, queue and host checks, cap startup retries at one, write the CoS alert in the terminal transaction, and name Git worktree checkout in host errors.
